name: DW3 Mods
about: Mod index for the recompiled Digimon World 3 builds (SLES-03936 Europe, SLUS-01436 USA).

mods.name: Warp / Teleport Tool (Fast Travel)
mods.summary: Open a destination list in the field and teleport to any of 239 field stages.
mods.controls: L2+R2 opens the list; D-pad moves, L1/R1 page, Cross warps, Triangle/Start exits.

mods.name: Save Anywhere
mods.summary: Open a Save Anywhere panel in the field with SELECT+SQUARE and save using the game's own memory-card screen.
mods.controls: SELECT+SQUARE opens the panel; D-pad picks SAVE GAME / CANCEL, Cross confirms, Triangle/Start exits. Confirming runs the game's own save screen.
